name: nworks
description: Control LINE WORKS / NAVER WORKS messages, calendar, drive, mail, tasks, boards, and contacts from AI agents.
long_description: CLI and MCP server for LINE WORKS (NAVER WORKS). Exposes 36 tools covering messages, calendar, drive, mail, tasks, and boards. Requires a Developer Console app (Client ID/Secret); see the onboarding guide.

client_secret.title: Client Secret
client_secret.description: OAuth Client Secret from the LINE WORKS Developer Console.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: OAuth Client ID. Optional if already stored via `nworks login`.
